title: rub; chafe
quiz_exclusions: [擦, 磨, 研]

摩 concerns rubbing, chafing or brushing against something. [摩擦](../words/摩擦.md) まさつ is friction or rubbing, and figuratively friction or discord between people or groups. A second, less common sense is drawing so near as to touch, as in 摩天楼 まてんろう, "skyscraper." The Daijisen character entry also records 摩 as a character used to write Sanskrit sounds, as in 摩訶 まか and 護摩 ごま, where it is not about rubbing.

distractors: [右, 川, 本]

- [毛](毛.md) shares モウ and [耕](耕.md) shares コウ. Their related
  shapes do not make them safe reading distractors. [右](右.md), right,
  [石](石.md), stone, and [未](未.md), not yet, instead have distinct
  lexical ranges. For the curated choices, [川](川.md), river, and
  [本](本.md), book or origin, likewise do not mean depletion or news.
  Their full ranges include source/base and counting uses, not just
  the first labels.

comparisons.disposition: Harmless: 際 covers an edge or occasion (窓際, その際), not a wall or fence; no direct pair declared; consistency with the 辺 guard noted as O3
Harmless: 限 limits amount, time or eligibility; no structure sense; no pair declared
Harmless: a gate is an entrance, and the 塀 word article treats a gate as related, not as the wall itself (snapshot/words/塀.md:31); no pair declared
Harmless: 城 names a castle only; no wall or fence sense in the card; no pair declared
Harmless: 節's music senses are melody, section and verse, not beat or clapping, and its title shows no music label; no pair declared
Harmless: singing and songs are not clapping or a beat; the 曲 guard on 拍 is a precaution, not a requirement (repo/kanji/曲.md:21-23)
Harmless: animal calls and ringing are not clapping or a beat; no pair declared
Harmless: resounding and influence, not clapping or beat; 響 guards 音 and 鳴 but not 拍, which is adequate

comparisons.reason: 討つ うつ attack vs 拍つ strike (repo/kanji/討.md:22-26)
comparisons.disposition: Harmless: 討つ is attacking or defeating an enemy, not clapping; 拍つ is a rare spelling in the separate 打つ family (evidence/jmdict-families.xml:116); no pair declared
Harmless: 拝 means worship or bowing; ritual clapping belongs to the word 拍手 or 柏手, not to 拝 (evidence/jmdict-families.xml:254)
Harmless: degrees and counting occasions; a beat is a musical unit, not an occurrence counter

comparisons.reason: marking senses in the 打つ family (repo/kanji/符.md:21)
comparisons.disposition: Harmless: 符 is a token, sign or ticket; the 打つ "mark" sense is not an ordinary bare-拍 sense (snapshot/kanji/拍.md:54-60)

Harmless: tiredness is a 消耗 whole-word sense; 耗's character senses are decrease and wearing down (evidence/external-snapshots/04-extract.txt:11)
Harmless: 乏 describes an insufficient state, not a decrease process; no pair declared
Harmless: missing or chipped, not decreasing through use
Harmless: the card limits 枯 to plants withering and explicitly warns against extending it
Harmless: 着's "wear" is putting on clothes, a different English sense; the full 耗 title "decrease; wear down through use" is distinct

comparisons.disposition: Harmless: ceasing and severing are not decrease; consistency with the unexplained 断 guard noted as O4
